currentParagraphText: “Few gods do, especially not those at my level. It isn’t due to cowardice, though. I’m working on things I need the power of my true body to handle. Meanwhile, exploring a World Wonder with an avatar is as efficient as if I’d gone with my real body, as it’s more than powerful enough,” the Viper said in a casual tone.
